not_this: It does not teach the model to summarize, explain, or answer questions about the documents.
It does not shorten, rewrite, or paraphrase anything.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model the exact wording of my documents so it can reproduce them as written.
goals.title: Learn the text itself
goals.what_the_model_learns: To reproduce the retained source passages as written. The whole passage is the training signal; nothing is held back as a question or prompt.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents whose cleaned text you want the model to learn. Nothing else is needed.

not_this: It does not invent new endings; the target is always the real remainder from the source.
It is not a summary, an answer, or a rewrite.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to keep writing a passage from a given starting point, in the document's own words.
goals.title: Continue a passage
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the opening part of a real source passage, produce the exact remainder of that same passage.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with passages long enough to split into an opening and a remainder.

not_this: It does not generate a body for a heading that has none in the source.
It does not summarize, outline, or reorder sections.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to write out a section's body when given that section's heading.
goals.title: Recover a section from its heading
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given an exact heading from the source, produce the exact section body beneath it.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with real headings and the text under them, such as Markdown, HTML, or Word documents with heading structure.

not_this: It does not teach general editing, rewriting, or style transfer beyond the recorded deterministic change.
It is not translation or summarization.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to apply a change that was actually recorded during cleaning, by showing the text before and after it.
goals.title: Reproduce a recorded change
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the text exactly as it was before one recorded cleaning change, produce the text exactly as it was after that change.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents cleaned with rules that recorded at least one before-and-after change.

not_this: It does not extract record fields, names, dates, or any value from the prose; only attributes that the recovered document structure explicitly records.
It does not infer, guess, or compute values that are not explicitly present in the source.
It is not question answering over the document.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to state one structural fact that the document's formatting explicitly records, such as a heading's level or a link's address.
goals.title: Extract a structural attribute
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the source context, emit exactly one attribute recorded during recovery: a heading level, a code block's language, a link or image address or title attribute, a math display flag, a citation key or locator, whether a list is ordered or an item is checked, or a table column alignment.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with recoverable formatting, such as Markdown, HTML, or Word documents. Plain text, JSON, and CSV sources record none of these attributes and yield nothing for this goal.

representations.plain_language: The passage itself is the training example. Every part of it is trained on.
representations.title: Whole text

representations.plain_language: A starting context taken from the source, followed by the exact source text that should come next. Only the completion is trained on.
representations.supervised_region: The completion only; the prompt is context.
representations.title: Prompt and completion

representations.plain_language: A short instruction you supply, the exact source context as input, and the exact source-derived output. Only the output is trained on, and the instruction must describe the real task.
representations.supervised_region: The output only; the instruction and input are context.
representations.title: Instruction and output

representations.plain_language: A two-turn conversation: the user turn is the exact source context and the assistant turn is the exact source-derived target. Only the assistant turn is trained on.
representations.supervised_region: The assistant turn only; the user turn is context.
representations.title: Conversation
